s1.syndrome_frame: inflammatory arthritis and skin lesions with systemic symptoms
key_facts: man in his 50s
dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
relief of symptoms with daily oral prednisone
flare of symptoms with taper below 10 mg
previous treatments included hydroxychloroquine and adalimumab without improvement
mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests
nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate on skin biopsy
atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes on skin biopsy
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining
clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample

raw.syndrome_frame: inflammatory arthritis and skin lesions with systemic symptoms
key_facts: man in his 50s
dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
relief of symptoms with daily oral prednisone
flare of symptoms with taper below 10 mg
previous treatments included hydroxychloroquine and adalimumab without improvement
mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests
nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate on skin biopsy
atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes on skin biopsy
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining
clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample

raw.rationale: The presence of pink-purple dermal papules, particularly on the extensor surfaces of the arms and legs, along with inflammatory arthritis and muscle symptoms such as fatigue and dyspnea on exertion, are characteristic of dermatomyositis. The skin biopsy findings of a nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate with atypical lymphocytes and numerous histiocytes, as well as the low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal, further support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: rheumatoid arthritis
rejected.why: While the patient has polyarticular inflammatory arthritis, the presence of characteristic skin findings and the lack of response to treatments like hydroxychloroquine and adalimumab make rheumatoid arthritis less likely.

rejected.label: vasculitis
rejected.why: There is no clear evidence of vasculitis on the skin biopsy or other tests, making this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: inflammatory arthritis
rejected.why: This is a broad term that encompasses several conditions, including rheumatoid arthritis and dermatomyositis. The specific findings in this case point more towards dermatomyositis.

rejected.label: polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis
rejected.why: The patient is in his 50s, making juvenile idiopathic arthritis an unlikely diagnosis.
